day7_mixer.subject: Meet the WTIA community

day7_mixer.body: Hello {recipientName}, build new connections across Hong Kong's technology community at an upcoming WTIA member event.

day14_profile.subject: Complete your WTIA member profile
day14_profile.preview: Help members and partners discover your expertise.
day14_profile.heading: Strengthen your member profile
day14_profile.body: Hello {recipientName}, complete your profile so the WTIA community can understand your expertise, interests and collaboration goals.

day30_recap.subject: Your first month with WTIA
day30_recap.preview: A quick recap of ways to participate.

day30_recap.body: Hello {recipientName}, revisit the events, member resources and community opportunities available during your first month with WTIA.

day45_content.subject: Fresh insight from the WTIA network

day60_committee.subject: Help shape the WTIA community
day60_committee.preview: Explore ways to contribute your experience.

day90_review.subject: Review your WTIA member experience
day90_review.preview: Tell us how your first 90 days have gone.

renewal_90.subject: Your WTIA membership renews in 90 days
renewal_90.preview: Plan ahead for uninterrupted member access.

renewal_90.body: Hello {recipientName}, your WTIA membership is due to renew in 90 days. Review your membership details and contact us if anything needs updating.

renewal_60.subject: Your WTIA membership renews in 60 days

renewal_30.subject: 30 days until your WTIA renewal
renewal_30.heading: Your membership renews soon
renewal_30.body: Hello {recipientName}, your WTIA membership renews in 30 days. Review the renewal details now to avoid any interruption.

renewal_14.subject: WTIA membership renewal in 14 days
renewal_14.preview: A final reminder before your renewal date.

dunning_0.subject: Action needed for your WTIA payment

dunning_3.subject: WTIA payment still needs attention
dunning_3.preview: Update your details to prevent an interruption.

dunning_3.body: Hello {recipientName}, your WTIA membership payment remains outstanding. Please update your payment details as soon as possible.

dunning_7.subject: Final WTIA payment reminder
dunning_7.preview: Your membership access may be interrupted.

lapsed_survey.subject: Tell us about your WTIA experience
lapsed_survey.preview: Your feedback will help us improve the member journey.

winback_21.subject: Stay connected with the WTIA community

AiOps.metaDescription: Live, privacy-safe metrics showing how WTIA's AI agents perform, escalate and cost.
AiOps.title: Operational AI, measured in public
AiOps.description: Hourly, privacy-safe evidence from WTIA's Concierge and scheduled agents.
AiOps.empty: No metrics are available for this month yet
AiOps.renewalChartDescription: Overall and first-year renewal rates for the latest twelve Hong Kong months.
AiOps.methodologyDescription: Aggregates refresh hourly. Estimated time saved equals agent-resolved conversations multiplied by six minutes. No member-level data is published.
AiOps.architectureDescription: Web and WhatsApp requests pass through the Concierge runtime and guarded tools. Scheduled jobs use authenticated routes. Generated actions remain behind approval or publication gates.
AiOps.noBuildLogs: No published build logs are available.
